profile.headline: Software Engineer at CFI Consultants, LLC.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Orange, New Jersey, United States · On-site

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
* Managed and trained the undergraduate employees of the Student Technology Assistance Program (STAP).
* Scheduled employees for coverage of the computer labs at the Monmouth University Library, Student Center, Student Help Desk, and Art Labs.
* Communicated with employees, Information Management staff, students, and university faculty to solve problems involving the university's provided technology services.
* Developed new protocols and methodologies to improve organization and efficiency.
* Collaborated with 4 other Graduate Assistants to solve and complete assigned supported tickets.
* Recorded, produced, and edited instructional videos to teach students and faculty how to use computer lab resources.

positions.title: Website Administrator
positions.description:
*Manage the online website for the Monmouth University newspaper, The Outlook.
*Archived old issues and update website with the week's current issue every Wednesday.
*Demonstrated knowledge of Joomla to preform changes on the website.
*Led the development team of the Android app for The Outlook

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description:
*Monitored Monmouth University computer labs and assisted students and staff with computer related issues.
*Supervised lab printers and made sure they stocked on paper, toner and functioned properly.
